# proxmox_node_hardware_usb (Data Source)

Lists the USB devices of one node from `/nodes/{node}/hardware/usb`, sorted by bus/port. Device ids are the `vendid:prodid` pair used by `proxmox_cluster_mapping_usb`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_hardware_usb" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `busnum` (Number)
- `class` (String)
- `devnum` (Number)
- `level` (Number)
- `manufacturer` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `prodid` (String)
- `product` (String)
- `serial` (String)
- `speed` (String)
- `usbpath` (String)
- `vendid` (String)
